text: Grandma June can't see her porch. Jo wants to fix that without a monthly bill.
Grandma, let's get you a video doorbell.
The catch: many doorbells save video only if you pay for a plan.
Saved video costs extra. Ring Solo is $49.99 a year, says ring.com.
Over three years, Ring with the Pro plan is $639.96 based on Target and maker prices, November 11, 2026.
The eufy E340 saves about 90 days of clips on 8 GB inside it. No fee, per eufy.
Look at you, my little engineer.
I can see the whole porch!
At a busy door, owners get weeks of charge, not months.
I'll charge it on Sundays, when I visit.
I know exactly who that is.
